items.title_zh: 星巴克CEO布莱恩·尼科尔称扭亏下一阶段聚焦门店改造与客户体验
items.summary: Starbucks is now two years into its turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.
items.summary_zh: 星巴克在CEO布莱恩·尼科尔领导下的扭亏为盈已进行两年。

items.title: Pilot pressed on with landing despite warnings in Miami cargo crash, NTSB says
items.title_zh: NTSB称迈阿密货机坠毁事件中飞行员不顾警告仍继续降落
items.summary: The NTSB said pilots continued with the landing of an Amazon cargo plane despite pilot and cockpit warnings about approach speed ahead of its Miami crash.
items.summary_zh: NTSB表示，在迈阿密坠毁前，尽管飞行员和驾驶舱就进近速度发出警告，飞行员仍继续让这架亚马逊货机降落。

items.title: Are the banking sector's hardest days over? After the interim reports, the real divergence is only beginning
items.title_zh: 银行业最难的日子过去了吗？中报之后，真正的分化才刚开始
items.summary: The 2026 interim reports show listed banks' revenue and pre-provision profit improving markedly, with net interest margin showing its first clear signs of stabilization; state-owned majors and quality city commercial banks stood out, while joint-stock banks continued to face retail credit risk pressure.
items.summary_zh: 2026年中报显示，上市银行营收与拨备前利润明显改善，净息差首次出现较清晰的企稳迹象，国有大行与优质城商行表现突出，股份行继续承受零售信用风险压力

items.title: Did US stocks miss the good news in front of them? Earnings estimates were upgraded unusually, and strategists say fundamentals are 'too strong to be true'
items.title_zh: 美股错过了眼前的“好消息”？盈利预期罕见上调，策略师：基本面强得“不像真的”
items.summary: Corporate earnings and US equity performance are diverging markedly: fundamentals keep improving while the market remains constrained by high rates and macro uncertainty, and earnings growth in some sectors is not yet fully reflected in prices.
items.summary_zh: 企业盈利与美股股价表现正出现明显背离：基本面持续改善，市场却仍被高利率和宏观不确定性牵制，部分板块的盈利增长尚未充分反映在股价中
